description: This file contains unit tests for the LocationHandler class in an Android application. It tests permission handling, location fetching behavior, fallback mechanisms, and error cases, using a FakeLocationDataSource for mocking location data sources.

classes.name: LocationHandlerTest
classes.description: Test class for LocationHandler, containing various test cases to verify location permission handling, location fetching, fallback logic, and error handling.

classes.name: FakeLocationDataSource
classes.description: Mock implementation of the LocationDataSource interface used in tests to simulate different location permission states and behaviors.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresLocationPermissionWhenNeitherFineNorCoarse
methods.description: Tests that location retrieval requires appropriate permissions when neither fine nor coarse permissions are granted.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_requiresForegroundBeforeLocationPermission
methods.description: Tests that foreground status is checked before location permission is granted.

methods.name: hasFineLocationPermission_reflectsDataSource
methods.description: Verifies that the hasFineLocationPermission() method reflects the permissions state from the data source.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_usesPreciseGpsFirstWhenFinePermissionAndPreciseEnabled
methods.description: Verifies that when fine permission and precise mode are enabled, GPS provider is used first with correct parameters.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_fallsBackToBalancedWhenPreciseUnavailable
methods.description: Checks fallback behavior when precise location is unavailable, ensuring balanced providers are used.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsTimeoutToLocationTimeout
methods.description: Ensures that a timeout during location fetching maps to a LOCATION_TIMEOUT error.

methods.name: handleLocationGet_mapsOtherFailuresToLocationUnavailable
methods.description: Ensures other failures in location fetching are mapped to LOCATION_UNAVAILABLE error.
